defect: A physically clear pocket between through-hole children was rejected because group projection demanded a single common separation direction for all active child pairs.
reproduction: Native exact Occupancy::fits_exhaustive accepted the 22x22 fixture while floorplan_legalize_compact rejected it before this patch; native_floorplan_contracts failed with 'exactly feasible child pocket rejected by group projection'.
correction: When no common-direction seed projection holds, retain independently witnessed seed separation directions for each active child pair. Keep normal common-direction handling otherwise. All final rounded geometry, hard constraints, halos and child occupancy remain independently checked.
coverage: Native floorplan contracts PASS 14.72 seconds, including both primary-face assignments, horizontal/vertical through-hole pockets, compaction on/off, and solid-obstacle rejection with caller rollback.

carrier_reference.quick_checks: fanout, ratsnest geometry, placement contract, placement flow PASS; hard_red=0

limitations: This correction represents already-clear seed pockets; it does not discover arbitrary new pockets. No attribution of USB-JTAG/HDMI failures to this defect, no smaller-board or timing improvement claimed, no fresh full audit/render qualification.
